annotations.title: Curated Domain Registry Scope & Source Authority Filter

description: Scopes search execution and filters results strictly across verified high-reputation domain registries and regulatory bodies. Use when restricting search discovery to verified academic papers, SEC filings, official documentation, or legal statutes; for checking specific factual claims, use verify_factual_claims instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'query' ('domain_tier' defaults to 'academic_and_research'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.
